violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Boba machine observed installed in establishment without approval.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: Boba machine. -Amendment has been submitted but was returned to customer for comment. Please continue application for approval.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed queso in steam well at 130F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Queso reheated to 165F.

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed machine for boba style drinks installed in the bar area without approval.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: Boba drink machine. EHS provided information and instructions for amendment submittal during the inspection.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Interior of microwave, interior of 3 Dr prep cooler unit.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Employee cleaned equipment during the inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the BAR 3 VAT SINK piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.
